articles.headline: Sri Lanka rescues 40 Iranian sailors
articles.brief: Sri Lankan authorities have successfully rescued 40 Iranian sailors following an offshore maritime distress incident, according to a government spokesperson.

articles.headline: Severe cyclone approaches Andhra Pradesh coast
articles.brief: A major depression over the Bay of Bengal is intensifying into a severe cyclonic storm, expected to cross the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coasts with destructive winds.

articles.headline: Storm Boelo disrupts UK transport and power
articles.brief: Storm Boelo has struck Scotland, Northern Ireland, and northern England with powerful winds and flooding, leaving over 82,000 homes without power and disrupting regional travel.

articles.headline: Thousands protest Czech public media overhaul
articles.brief: Thousands of demonstrators gathered in the Czech Republic to protest a controversial public media overhaul pushed through Parliament via a rushed legislative vote.

articles.headline: Trump gears up for potential Iran escalation
articles.brief: US officials have signaled potential military strategies against Iran following upcoming midterms, bolstering regional deployments as Tehran vows strong retaliation.

articles.headline: India-EU FTA signing targeted for December
articles.brief: The European Commission is reportedly pushing for a fast-track approval of the India-EU Free Trade Agreement, targeting a formal signing during high-level meetings in Brussels.

articles.headline: Big-ticket investment deals face a slowdown
articles.brief: Major corporate investments in India are experiencing a cautious dip as global financial backers reevaluate capital deployment amid changing macroeconomic indicators.

articles.headline: Citibank calls for shifting India's AI narrative
articles.brief: Citibank executives emphasize that India must reshape its artificial intelligence commercial strategy to focus more on localized productivity and economic resilience.

articles.headline: NASA shares crucial updates on Artemis IV
articles.brief: NASA administration has detailed upcoming lunar docking exercises and broader cooperation frameworks with private space enterprises as the agency plans for a permanent Moon base.

articles.headline: Melioidosis infection remains widely undetected in India
articles.brief: A comprehensive multicentre study reveals that high-risk hospitalised patients frequently suffer from undetected melioidosis, pointing to critical gaps in national surveillance.

articles.headline: Pakistan stuns England with historic final partnership
articles.brief: A record-breaking 89-run last-wicket partnership between Shadab Khan and Haris Rauf propelled Pakistan to a miraculous victory against England in a thrilling ODI encounter.

articles.headline: Borr Drilling rig sinks off the coast of Gabon
articles.brief: An offshore drilling rig operated by Borr Drilling has sunk off Gabon's coast, leaving one person dead and four others reported missing as rescue operations continue.

articles.headline: UAE beaches closed following offshore oil spill
articles.brief: Authorities in Ras Al Khaimah and neighboring emirates have ordered the indefinite closure of public beaches while teams grapple with an ongoing offshore oil leak.

articles.headline: Technology resilience vital for economic growth
articles.brief: Global advisory leaders note that emerging nations must urgently strengthen their technological foundations to withstand future macroeconomic supply shocks.

articles.headline: Venezuelan opposition leader returns from exile
articles.brief: Nobel laureate and prominent Venezuelan opposition figure Maria Corina Machado has returned to the country following nearly a year spent living in forced exile.
